scenes.title: No clients yet is not a character flaw.
scenes.body: It is a labeling problem. Sample work, personal projects, and clear process still count when you do not pretend they are paid case studies.
scenes.voice: No clients yet is not a character flaw. It is a labeling problem. Sample work, personal projects, and clear process still count when you do not pretend they are paid case studies.
scenes.cta: SHOW REAL WORK. LABEL IT HONESTLY.

scenes.title: Never claim what did not happen.
scenes.body: No fake logos. No invented metrics. No 'client' language for self-assigned practice. Honesty is a feature.
scenes.voice: The rule. Never claim what did not happen. No fake logos. No invented metrics. No client language for self-assigned practice. Honesty is a feature, not a bug.

scenes.title: Rebuild something that exists (publicly).
scenes.body: Take a real public site or product. Redesign one page or rewrite one flow. Show before and after. Label it as a redesign study.
scenes.voice: Option one. Rebuild something that already exists publicly. Take a real site or product. Redesign one page or rewrite one flow. Show before and after. Label it clearly as a redesign study.

scenes.title: Solve a real problem for free once.
scenes.body: Help a friend, a nonprofit, a local shop, or an open-source project. Document the problem, your process, and the result. Get permission to show it.
scenes.voice: Option two. Solve a real problem for free once. Help a friend, a nonprofit, a local shop, or an open-source project. Document the problem, your process, and the result. Get permission to show it.

scenes.title: Publish the process itself.
scenes.body: A detailed teardown, a how-I-would-fix series, or a sample deliverable pack. Process transparency builds trust faster than empty case studies.
scenes.voice: Option three. Publish the process itself. A detailed teardown, a how I would fix this series, or a sample deliverable pack. Process transparency builds trust faster than empty case studies.

scenes.title: Say exactly what it is.
scenes.body: 'Sample project', 'personal study', 'pro-bono for [name]', 'redesign concept'. Never 'client work' if it was not.
scenes.voice: Labeling. Say exactly what it is. Sample project. Personal study. Pro-bono for this organization. Redesign concept. Never call it client work if it was not.

scenes.title: Show the thinking, not just the final pretty.
scenes.body: Problem statement. Constraints. Decisions you made. What you would do differently next time. That is the real portfolio.
scenes.voice: Evidence. Show the thinking, not just the final pretty picture. Problem statement. Constraints. Decisions you made. What you would do differently next time. That is the real portfolio.

scenes.title: Ship one honest piece this week.
scenes.body: Pick one option. Produce it. Label it correctly. Put it where people can see it. Then go find the first paid version of the same thing.
